replies.author: pianoboy777
replies.body: No I developed it in godot , the mountains , hills , rivers and and grass are all procedure. The world is being developed at the same time as my world builder , which is why its all so boring and flat. Im not sure I'll be able to beat the low poly look though I want it to stay playable in a single browser tab like it does now.

replies.body: Don't think that will be easy, you need to make use of webgpu that unity offers, godot hasn't figured out webgpu yet because they refuse to acknowledge webgpu development with ai assistance.

replies.author: pianoboy777
replies.body: I couldn't do it so it much be hard lol that's what low poly is for. And this isn't my first 3d system just the most flexible one iv made. I didn't even get it ready for html5 lol my codes just that light lolol all the car physics, the player movement the building placement all work on html5. And u didn't even show off the custom FBX chop shop I made . It looks at the raw parts of any fbx you trow at it and lets you customize the color it all. Through this system is also how you'll add decals and stuff like car spoilers.
